scope: Browser runtime bytes only. Models, textures, user animations, Node preparation tools, sourcemaps and declarations are separate.

baseline.note: Pre-maturity Windows Node 24 build; zlib output may vary slightly with the supported Node version. VRM bundle includes Three.js, three-vrm, core and the author-owned fallback Idle. Limits allow roughly 10% raw/encoded VRM growth; changing them requires a measured reason. Inochi2D retains its existing 1.5 MiB raw limit; new encoded limits allow roughly 12% growth.

measurement.note: A fixed-scene physical-GPU target and same-machine relative software regression gate; neither is a promise for arbitrary avatars/devices. No GPU-memory estimate is inferred from JS heap.

ownedBrowserWeiguang.scope: Isolated Windows Chrome 155 process tree, RTX 5080, fixed Weiguang blog model at 320x480 DPR1 30FPS; sampled WDDM GPU counters are separate from RAM. Not a universal avatar/device promise.
